name: @adcode/desktop
description: The ADCode workbench: Electron shell, Monaco editing surface, xterm terminal.
//desktopName: Linux window association. Electron reads this at startup to set app_id and WM_CLASS - before main/index.ts calls app.setName - so without it the window identifies as `@adcode/desktop` while the installed entry says `ADCode`, and GNOME shows a pinned ADCode next to a second unlabelled icon for the window actually open. Paired with linux.syncDesktopName in electron-builder.yml, which makes the installed filename and StartupWMClass agree with it. Guarded by apps/desktop/test/packagingConfig.test.ts.
